scope: Code correctness and integration, not trained game-to-real image quality

checks.cpu_training: passed actual optimizer, validation, checkpoint, resume, and inference paths
checks.ddp: passed two real Gloo CPU processes with FileStore, gradient accumulation, mixed temporal guides, validation, EMA selection, checkpoint and resume
checks.cuda_bf16: passed actual backward and optimizer steps with pretrained VGG16, DINOv2 and SegFormer; feature R1 and gradient accumulation enabled

default_generator_capacity.status: passed forward, backward, optimizer, EMA and validation
default_generator_capacity.note: Full default generator capacity; smaller crops and teacher views than the H800 preset

checks.pretrained_teacher_preparation: passed real downloads and local safetensors/feature-weight export
checks.content_candidate_retrieval: passed actual DINO descriptor extraction, chunked nearest-neighbor search and index write
checks.inference_and_content_evaluation: passed CUDA EMA image inference and DINO/semantic report generation with original-size PNG outputs
checks.packaging: passed editable installation and installed CLI entry points
checks.linux_launcher: passed bash -n syntax check under WSL

not_verified: H800 memory capacity, throughput, and torchrun/NCCL execution
512x512 full quality configuration on production hardware
Training or image quality on the user's GTA5 and SeSekai2 datasets
Real-data hyperparameter optimality or state-of-the-art quality
FID/KID runtime path and downloaded Inception weights
Video consistency without supplied sequence/flow supervision
local_launcher_limitation: The local Windows wheel's torchrun TCP rendezvous failed because libuv support was absent. DDP training itself was subsequently tested with an independently initialized FileStore/Gloo process group. The server launcher targets Linux NCCL.
fixtures: Procedurally generated test patterns only; they are not photorealism training evidence
